does not answer, the row stays and still describes the file.

company.title: Company
company.description: The company's name, up to 100 characters.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title of the role applied for, up to 100 characters.

Application.title: Application
Application.description: One job a person has applied to: the company and the title of the role.

watch.title: Watch
watch.description: Companies whose postings they want to see, each up to 100 characters; at most 30.

applied.title: Applied
applied.description: Jobs they have already applied to, so a posting for one is not suggested again; at most 50, the same company with another title being another job.

Companies.title: Companies
Companies.description: Companies a person keeps an eye on, and the jobs they have already applied to.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Industries they will not work in, each up to 100 characters; at most 30.

company_sizes.title: Company Sizes
company_sizes.description: Company sizes, by number of employees, they will not work at.

no_agencies.title: No Agencies
no_agencies.description: Whether a posting from a recruiting agency, not the employer, rules it out.

DealBreakers.title: DealBreakers
DealBreakers.description: What rules a posting out for a person whatever else it offers.

apply_with.title: Apply With
apply_with.description: Requirements they lack but would still apply without, in their words, each up to 200 characters; at most 20.

trade_offs.title: Trade Offs
trade_offs.description: What they would give up for the right role, in their words, each up to 200 characters; at most 20.

Gaps.title: Gaps
Gaps.description: Where a person falls short of a posting and still applies, and what they would give up.

Lead.title: Lead
Lead.description: One open posting scored for the person: enough to judge it and follow the link.

Leads.title: Leads
Leads.description: A page of the person's leads, best first, and how many they have in all.

city.title: City
city.description: The city's name as the person typed it, up to 100 characters.

days_a_week.title: Days A Week
days_a_week.description: Days a week in the office, from 1 to 5; 5 means on site.

Office.title: Office
Office.description: A city a person would go into an office in, and how often.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Anything else a posting must or must not be, in their words, each up to 300 characters; at most 20.

OwnRules.title: OwnRules
OwnRules.description: Rules of a person's own, in their words, that no other section covers.

leads_per_day.title: Leads Per Day
leads_per_day.description: Postings to show a day, from 1 to 50.

brief_from_score.title: Brief From Score
brief_from_score.description: The lowest score, from 1 to 5, at which a posting gets a written brief; null for no briefs.

Pace.title: Pace
Pace.description: How many postings a person wants a day, and which deserve a written brief.

floor_usd.title: Floor Usd
floor_usd.description: The lowest annual base pay, in whole US dollars, they would take.

ask_usd.title: Ask Usd
ask_usd.description: The annual base pay, in whole US dollars, they ask for; at least the floor.

Pay.title: Pay
Pay.description: What a person will be paid: annual base pay in whole US dollars, before bonus or equity.

remote_ok.title: Remote Ok
remote_ok.description: Whether a fully remote role is fine.

offices.title: Offices
offices.description: Cities, as typed, where they would go into an office, and how many days a week; at most 20, one per city.

states.title: States
states.description: US states they can work from, as two-letter postal codes, DC included; any case is taken and stored in upper case.

will_relocate.title: Will Relocate
will_relocate.description: Whether they would move for a role.

relocate_for.title: Relocate For
relocate_for.description: Companies they would move for even though they would not move otherwise, each up to 100 characters; at most 20, and empty when they would move anyway.

Places.title: Places
Places.description: Where a person will work: remote, offices in named cities, US states, and moving.

target_titles.title: Target Titles
target_titles.description: Job titles they are looking for, each up to 100 characters; at most 20.

title_range.description: Null until the person saves this section.

places.description: Null until the person saves this section.

pay.description: Null until the person saves this section.

skills.description: Null until the person saves this section.

gaps.description: Null until the person saves this section.

deal_breakers.description: Null until the person saves this section.

companies.description: Null until the person saves this section.

pace.description: Null until the person saves this section.

own_rules.description: Null until the person saves this section.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: The whole profile, as stored and as answered.

Resume.title: Resume
Resume.description: The signed-in person's resume, or null before their first upload.

name.title: Name
name.description: The skill, as the person names it, up to 60 characters.

years.title: Years
years.description: Whole years of using it, from 0 to 60; 0 means under a year.

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: One skill and how long the person has used it.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Their skills, each named once; at most 100.

titles.title: Titles
titles.description: Job titles they are looking for, each up to 100 characters; at most 20.

TargetTitles.title: TargetTitles
TargetTitles.description: The body that replaces the target titles. An empty list means none chosen.

nearby_titles.title: Nearby Titles
nearby_titles.description: Job titles close to the target titles that are also worth seeing, each up to 100 characters; at most 20.

lower_level_ok.title: Lower Level Ok
lower_level_ok.description: Whether a role one level below the target titles is fine.

TitleRange.title: TitleRange
TitleRange.description: How far from their target titles a person will look.
